BiblicalUsage: Two chains of pure gold at the ends, of wreathen work, were fastened to the ouches of the breastplate. The word is the border itself, the wreathen edge, and it is named once, in the making of the high priest's garments.
TheologicalSignificance: I notice that even the chains have their border: gold, wreathen, fastened to the ouches, because the breastplate that bore the tribes was finished in gold.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
